name: MediaWiki
description: MediaWiki is the wiki software behind Wikipedia, built for collaborative documentation at any scale. Every page keeps a full revision history, and templates, categories, file uploads and a visual editor make it easy to structure and grow a knowledge base. Thousands of extensions add features like Lua modules, syntax highlighting and two-factor login.

notes.text: Log in with the admin user and generated password from /opt/mediawiki_data/.env inside the container.
By default anyone can read, edit and create an account. Restrict this with $wgGroupPermissions in /opt/mediawiki_data/LocalSettings.php before exposing the wiki.
Links and redirects use the container IP. For a domain or reverse proxy, set $wgServer in /opt/mediawiki_data/LocalSettings.php.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: At least 10 characters; generated when left empty
